name: mscse-zero-credit-course
description: A course whose credit-hours column came through blank and was saved as 0. Zero is allowed — refusing the row would lose a course the student passed — but it is never silent (DGS 2026-09-11: "allow 0 credits for courses with grades, but show a warning message"). Until then the line read a bare "not counted", with no reason, no warning and nothing pointing at the credits field.

CSE 60567: not counted — entered with 0 credits; check the credit hours on your transcript
